eyebrow: General Purpose tier — HA via compute reattach
caption: Compute and storage are separated — a failed node reattaches to the same durable, remote storage.

eyebrow: Business Critical tier — HA via a synchronized cluster
caption: A cluster of nodes with local storage, kept in sync — any replica can take over almost instantly.

code:
HIGH AVAILABILITY                    DISASTER RECOVERY
Survives: a node/rack failure         Survives: a regional outage
Scope: local, same region             Scope: a different geography
Downtime: seconds, often automatic    Downtime: minutes-hours, a decision
Data loss: typically zero             Data loss: typically some (minutes)
caption: Neither service tier's HA architecture is, by itself, disaster recovery.

subtitle: The business decisions that pick the tool, not the other way around.
